title: 6.5 Extract Number
prompt: 6.5 Write code using find() and string slicing to extract the number at the end of the line below. Convert the extracted value to a floating point number and print it out.

student.py.solution:
text = "X-DSPAM-Confidence:    0.8475"
atpos = text.find(":")
piece = text[atpos+1:]
stripped = piece.strip()
flt = float(stripped)
print(flt)
